team_0.color: White shirts with dark shoulder trim, navy blue shorts, dark socks

plays.summary: Our centre-back tracks a long ball in behind, shields the opponent attacker away from danger, and our goalkeeper comes off his line to claim the ball cleanly.

players.note: Composed recovery positioning and physical shielding reminiscent of Virgil van Dijk.
Decisive sweeping off the line to smother the danger just like Alisson Becker.

plays.summary: Our centre-back intercepts a dangerous through ball inside the penalty area and passes across to a teammate who calmly clears upfield under pressure.

players.note: Sharp reading of the passing lane to cut out danger before it develops, much like Thiago Silva.
Calm first touch under pressure to relieve danger and launch the ball into space like John Stones.

plays.summary: Our central midfielder wins an aerial duel to flick the ball forward, and our striker dribbles past a defender in midfield before drawing a foul.

players.note: Strong aerial commitment to win the second ball in midfield like Rodri.
Explosive turn and direct dribbling under pressure to win a free kick like Harry Kane.

plays.summary: Our midfielder delivers a lofted free kick from just inside the opponent half toward the left side of the penalty box to contest the aerial ball.

players.note: Next time aim the delivery closer to the penalty spot so attackers can attack the ball heading toward goal.

plays.summary: Our midfielder steps in cleanly to dispossess an advancing opponent and immediately drives a long pass forward into space.

players.note: Aggressive front-foot ball winning followed by immediate vertical distribution like Declan Rice.

plays.summary: Our centre-back makes a full-speed recovery run to match the opponent striker stride for stride and blocks the danger out for a corner kick.

players.note: Relentless recovery pace and last-ditch defending in a 1v1 duel just like Kyle Walker.

plays.summary: After defending a corner, our right-back intercepts and sparks a fast counter-attack through our central midfielder, who dribbles past a defender and threads a through ball for our left winger to shoot.

players.note: Quick defensive-to-offensive transition pass out of danger like Trent Alexander-Arnold.
Line-breaking dribble and weighted through ball on the counter just like Kevin De Bruyne.
Next time take one fewer touch inside the box or look across the six-yard box for a square pass if the shooting angle narrows.

plays.summary: The opponent hits a long free kick into our defensive third, wins the second ball, dribbles past our defender inside the box, and scores past our goalkeeper.

players.note: Win the first contact decisively or drop a yard deeper to protect the space behind on long free kicks.
Stay patient on your feet and delay the attacker toward the outside rather than getting beaten inside the penalty box.
Get set early as the shooter prepares to strike so you have a strong base to react to low shots across goal.
